name: Isosurface Extraction with Topological Optimization
definition: A global strategy for isosurface extraction that optimizes topological and combinatorial measures (triangle count, genus, number of shells) by making decisions on ambiguous faces (X-faces) and multi-loop cubes (X-cubes), rather than using local criteria.
summary: Isosurface Extraction with Topological Optimization extracts triangle meshes by globally optimizing topological properties like genus and component count, rather than relying on local disambiguation rules.
